name: baseline
description: Shift-left + admission baseline: supply chain, CVE budget, and PSS-style workload hardening.

rules.description: Images from the internal registry are pre-approved and exempt from the deny rules below.
Every image must carry a verified signature from a trusted key.
rules.message: image is not signed by a trusted key
rules.remediation: Sign the image and push the bundle: dsecrat sign --image <ref> --key <key>

rules.description: No critical CVEs may reach production.
rules.remediation: Rebuild on a patched base image or upgrade the affected packages to clear critical CVEs.

rules.description: At most a handful of high CVEs are tolerated; beyond that, block.
rules.remediation: Reduce high-severity findings below the budget before deploying.

rules.description: Image references should be pinned to a digest, not a mutable tag.
rules.message: image is not pinned to a digest
rules.remediation: Reference the image by digest (name@sha256:...) so the deployed artifact is immutable.

rules.description: Containers must not run as root (PSS restricted).
rules.message: workload runs as root (uid 0 / runAsNonRoot not set)
rules.remediation: Set securityContext.runAsNonRoot: true and a non-zero runAsUser.

rules.description: Host network/PID/IPC namespaces break container isolation.
rules.remediation: Remove hostNetwork/hostPID/hostIPC from the pod spec.

rules.description: Copyleft licenses incompatible with distribution are disallowed.
rules.message: image contains a package under a restricted license
rules.remediation: Replace the offending dependency or obtain a license exception.

waivers.reason: legacy base image scheduled for replacement in Q1; risk accepted
